content: A skill set holds skills: instructions that tell the assistant how to do a task. Connect it to a chat or an agent.

comment.text: Description on the empty screen of the Skill sets list in the AI Chat section for a user who may create one: what a skill set is and why to create it. Terms: agent = an AI assistant set up with a model, skill sets and knowledge bases; skill set = a room of skills (Markdown instructions); knowledge base = a room of files the assistant searches. Match Common:Agents, Common:SkillSets, Common:AIProjectKnowledgeRooms.
